变声、录音与模型推理都在本机完成，录音和模型不会上传。联网用于检查更新、下载模型: Voice changing, recording and model inference all run on your device; recordings and models are never uploaded. The network is used to check for updates, download models and assets, read the sponsor list, and fetch announcements and recommendations. After you accept the notice, basic stats are reported: app launches, views and clicks of announcements and recommendations, plus app version, system language and a random install ID. Optional anonymous analytics is checked by default in the consent dialog; when on, it also reports device model, OS version, feature-usage events and crash info (no recordings or personal info). You can turn it off any time in About → Other. Logs stay on your device; only when you export and share them yourself, or submit via "Feedback", are the text you entered and the logs and screenshots you chose uploaded.

• Feature usage events, such as starting/stopping AI voice changing (ai_start / ai_stop), switching voices, applying presets, file conversion and text-to-speech, with numbers like duration, tier, inference time and load (used to pick default tiers per device)
• On a crash, the exception class name and a few stack frames of this app
• A randomly generated install ID (not linked to your identity; changes when you reinstall)
